finnish_support: "Finnish" is in SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES of the qwen-asr 0.0.6 package (asserted in the notebook before any test run)
decoding: greedy; language forced to "Finnish" (no auto-detection); max_new_tokens=256; qwen-asr transformers backend
pipeline_check: 8 dev_cv clips only (output must be non-empty Finnish text); no setting tuned on the test sets
normalization_and_scoring: scripts/asr_eval.py (shared project normalize() and corpus WER/CER)
notes: Standard pretrained Qwen3-ASR 1.7B; no additional training by the group. float16 because the T4 has no native bfloat16; a float16 vs float32 check on development clips showed no accuracy difference (see precision_check). The optional Qwen3-ASR-0.6B run (RUN_06B in the notebook) was not performed. Prediction files have the same clip ids and references as the dataset clip lists in data/.

precision_check.data: 400 development clips (200 dev_cv + 200 dev_parl, evenly spaced); no test clips
precision_check.decision: keep float16 (rule: re-run test sets only if float32 is at least 1.0 WER lower on dev)
